title: What is your return policy?
text: You can return most new, unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Items must include original packaging and proof of purchase. Final-sale and personalised items are not eligible. Start a return from Your Orders or bring the item to any participating store with the receipt.

title: How do I request a refund?
text: After your return is received and inspected, refunds are typically issued within 5–10 business days. Gift-card purchases are refunded to store credit. If the refund does not appear after 10 business days, contact customer support with your order number and return tracking ID.

title: How long does delivery take?
text: Standard delivery usually takes 3–5 business days after shipping. Express options are available at checkout for next-day or two-day delivery in eligible postcodes. You will receive a tracking number by email once the parcel leaves our fulfilment centre.

title: My package arrived damaged
text: We are sorry your delivery arrived damaged. Please photograph the packaging and item, then report the issue within 48 hours via Track Delivery or customer service. We will arrange a free replacement or full refund. Do not discard the damaged goods until the claim is confirmed.

title: What payment methods do you accept?
text: We accept major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and selected store gift cards. Some high-value orders may require additional verification. Payment is authorised at checkout and captured when the order ships.

title: What are your store opening hours?
text: Most stores open Monday–Saturday 09:00–21:00 and Sunday 10:00–18:00 local time. Holiday hours vary by location. Check Store Location for the specific branch, including click-and-collect cut-off times for same-day pickup.

title: Is this product available in store?
text: Use Check Availability and select your preferred store. Stock levels update throughout the day. If an item is unavailable locally, you can reserve nearby stock for pickup or request a ship-to-store transfer that typically completes within 2–4 business days.

title: How do I track my order?
text: Open Track Order with your order number and email, or use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation. Status updates include picked, packed, in transit, and out for delivery. If tracking stalls for more than 48 hours after the expected scan, contact support so we can investigate with the carrier.
